name: Christopher Alexander Whitmore
extra_bullets: Paired with the data team to add delivery time estimates to the dispatch dashboard, which cut customer calls about late loads by roughly a fifth in the first month
Rewrote the grading rubric for linked-list assignments so feedback came back within 48 hours instead of a week, and shared it with the other eight TAs
Documented setup steps for 14 lab printers in the help desk wiki, which new student workers now use during their first week on the job
cover_letter_paragraph: I also care about the people who use the tools. During my internship I spent two mornings riding along with dispatchers to see where the old export slowed them down, and those notes shaped the first version of the API. I would bring the same habit to your team and check what users need before writing code.

extra_reference.name: Daniel Brooks
extra_reference.relationship: Code reviewer and mentor during my internship
